descriptions: A person on a motorcycle swerves sharply to the right, moving from the center of the road towards the roadside vegetation.
The camera car drives forward on a narrow road. A dark SUV and a white car are parked ahead on the right side of the road, remaining stationary throughout the sequence.
A white SUV drives away from the camera car on a narrow, winding road. The vehicle remains in its lane and continues forward without any sudden movements or interactions with other road users.
A dark car drives away in the left lane. A pedestrian crosses the street from right to left ahead of the camera car.
A maroon sedan remains in the left lane ahead, maintaining its position. A dark SUV further ahead continues straight without deviation. No sudden movements, crossings, or collisions occur.
A black classic car on the left lane moves forward and exits frame. A dark sedan ahead continues straight in its lane. Pedestrians walk along sidewalks; none enter the roadway.
A gray car on the right remains stationary. Distant vehicles ahead maintain their lanes without sudden movements.
A pedestrian crosses the street from right to left in front of the camera car, moving into its direct path.
A dark blue sedan in the left lane moves forward and turns right into an intersection ahead. A white bus remains stationary in the distance.
A yellow sedan crosses from left to right in front of the camera car and exits the frame.
A maroon van exits from the left and moves ahead in its lane. A silver sedan drives straight ahead in the center lane.
A pedestrian runs from the sidewalk into the street, crossing directly in front of the camera car's lane.
A black convertible and red SUV are initially visible on the right. The black car moves out of view, followed by the red SUV as the camera car advances.
A green car drives straight ahead in its lane. Two pedestrians walk on the sidewalk to the right, moving away from the camera.
A pedestrian in red pants walks along the sidewalk on the right. A person in a green top stands near a food cart and then moves slightly. Another pedestrian is visible further down the sidewalk.
